verdict.rationale: Jira's docs describe breaking work into actionable tasks and assigning them to the right person. A hands-on community report confirms engineers routinely assign tickets to teammates, though another user notes a ticket can't be assigned to more than one person. No evidence item explicitly documents setting due dates; the calendar and timeline views only imply date fields. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of due-date fields on tasks, first-party docs on manual task creation and assignment beyond the AI-assist framing, support for multiple assignees.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates
